title: A reviewer can run a guard probe through a helper, without writing a script file
why: Lane notes-fix-large-1 (session_013NEJL4DPEKRiC91yHkQV7m), 16:11 CST Nov 8. Reviewer agents have no Write tool, and the harness's worktree-isolation check ("too complex to verify that it stays inside the worktree") refuses even one plain heredoc writing a probe script to the scratchpad, with no git call and no chaining. Effect: the last 6 reviews (#2171 R3, #1458 and #1774 fix checks, #2288 R1, #2295 R1 and R2) rested on static reads, and three reviewers tried to encode around the refusal (step encoded-retry-after-refusal). That refusal is the harness's, outside this repo (step scratch-git-in-isolated-agent). Fix in the repo: a helper the reviewer role may run, e.g. `bin/probe-guard <family> <cmd>`, that passes a command text through the hook in-process and prints its verdict. Meanwhile the lane routes probes through test-author cases.
